assessment:
N/A — no wishes. Zero cards in the 99 carry a library search, enumerated over all 100 entries by oracle text: not one contains 'search your library', on either face. `deck-audit`'s tutors axis reads 0 copies of tutor:unrestricted or tutor:narrow and files the axis as informational, and `validate-tutor-guide`'s own `deck_tutors()` returns an empty set for this list. There are no fetch lands either, and a fetch land would not count here in any case — land searching belongs to mana-analysis.

That is a fact about how the deck is built, not an omission. The engine declaration marks exactly one group `required` — a wheel — and the redundancy that a tutor would buy is already bought in bulk: 17 hand-refill effects in the 99, drawn in 0.990 of games and 0.949 by turn six, mean turn 1.718 (goldfish_metrics, 10,000 games, seed 42). A deck that finds its enabler in 95 games out of 100 by turn six does not need a card that finds it in 100.

Where a tutor WOULD earn its slot is the half the wheels cannot fix. The second per-discard damage source is a two-card group — Glint-Horn Buccaneer, Magmakin Artillerist — drawn in 0.660 of games and only 0.347 by turn six; commander protection is a two-card group — Lightning Greaves, Swiftfoot Boots — at 0.651 and 0.338, the lowest by-turn-six rate of the twelve declared groups. Those are the two wishes this deck would make if it had one, and both are shortages of REDUNDANCY rather than of searching. Naming them is a finding for the branch bench, not coaching for the table: at the table there is nothing to wish for, so the mulligan does the whole job. See the `mulligan` key.
gaps: No maindeck library-search tutor exists in this list, so there is no per-tutor coaching to write. The routine returns N/A rather than an empty section.

Adjacent selection that is NOT a tutor and is deliberately excluded: Curator of Mysteries (scry 1 on cycling), Treasure Map // Treasure Cove (scry 1 per activation), Containment Construct and Currency Converter (replay or buy back a card you discarded, from exile, not from the library), Jaxis, the Troublemaker (copies a creature already on the battlefield). Selection is not searching and none of these reaches the library.

Brallin's 'Partner with' trigger is the closest thing here to a library fetch and it is a blank in this deck: 'target player may put Shabraz into their hand from their library, then shuffle' cannot find her, because both Brallin and Shabraz are commanders and start in the command zone, not the library. It also says 'put ... from their library' rather than 'search your library', so the validator's tutor detector does not see it either.
Gemstone Caverns is the one card that changes what your opening seven is, and it is a land with an opening-hand replacement rather than a search. It belongs to the mulligan discussion, not here.

If a tutor is ever added, the two targets to write first are a second per-discard damage source (0.347 by turn six) and commander protection (0.338 by turn six, the lowest of the twelve declared groups).
